THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -3-  CRL.P No. 8801 of 2022  ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioner was absent when the matter was called at 10.40 a.m.
Even when the matter was again called at 3.45 p.m., there is no representation.
On the last date of hearing i.e., on 14.11.2022, there was no representation.
There is no progress in the matter.
Hence, I do not find any reason to adjourn the matter.
Accordingly, petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
